title: New Miles Plug tracks vehicles and aids in emergencies
excerpt: The $99 Miles Plug connects to a car's OBD-II port to monitor location, driving habits, and vehicle health while offering emergency response.
body_html:
A new device named the Miles Plug has been introduced for $99, designed to connect directly into a vehicle's OBD-II port. The small gadget is tailored to monitor various aspects of driving and vehicle status.

The device provides several monitoring features, including tracking vehicle location, analyzing driving habits, and checking overall vehicle health. In addition to monitoring capabilities, the product offers emergency accident response and roadside assistance functions.
